before_times: a new or a current patient

a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, or another adult
after_time: anything the office should know to help, like needing an interpreter or a step-free door
the name and mobile of the person booking
secure_page_only: the patient's legal name and birth date, and home address
the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the health history and the medicines taken
a release so the office can get records from the last endocrinologist

'I'm 18 or older, booking for myself', or how the person booking is related to the patient

intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, reasons, medicines or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; another adult (a grown child, a caregiver) only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; nobody under 18 is booked here (adults only), and nothing about a minor is kept
intake_questions.who_may_bring: an adult patient may bring a helper only with their own OK; no child is brought (adults only)

stop.words: a low blood sugar that doesn't come up after treatment, or someone confused, passing out or having a seizure from low sugar, vomiting that won't stop with a very high sugar reading, fast breathing with confusion, chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, fainting, or very heavy bleeding
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now. Don't wait for a booking.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked

stop.words: an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: someone feeling sick with nothing on the lists above
go_on.what: matched to the office's own follow-up visit, only after the endocrinologist's OK; Rosie never judges how sick someone is or what care they need

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about suicide or self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before check-in); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; current patients update them before each follow-up
steps.result: not done by its due date: the owner keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the front desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand; checked again a few days before the visit
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: Records from the last endocrinologist
steps.when: the patient signs a release on the secure page; the office gets them, office to office
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new patient
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID, the plan card, your medicines or a list of them, your meter or glucose log if you keep one, and your recent lab results; the secure page says if any test needs a prep first; at home: have the plan card and your medicines ready

staff.skills: endocrinologists and nurse practitioners: new patients, follow-up visits, video follow-ups and house calls; nurses: diabetes teaching visits on the endocrinologist's order; home blood draws: someone the owner has cleared for them; only people cleared for house calls go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: any license the owner wants shown, as given, per person; Rosie never checks it (D96)
staff.supervision: a nurse practitioner works within the state's rules for supervision or a collaboration agreement (a switch from the owner's own rules); where a supervising clinician must be reachable, they're offered only on those days
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs every new patient's first visit, same-day times for a new patient, and anything a nurse flags
staff.stand_in: the endocrinologist out: the nurse practitioner may take the visit, with the patient's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; another adult (a grown child, a caregiver) only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; nobody under 18 is booked here (adults only), and nothing about a minor is kept
children_and_age.minors_texts: nothing about a minor is texted or kept: no minor is booked here (adults only)
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor: not applicable (adults only)

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk, then the desk checks the photo ID and the plan card against the secure page; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the patient at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, results and medicines stay in the office's own records, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a lab order or a teaching visit is added only with the patient's yes, with any self-pay price first; more care is booked as its own visit only if the patient asks; follow-ups and labs are booked at checkout
visit.before_work: a medical assistant or nurse checks the vital signs and the medicines list before the exam, and a glucose reading if the office does one

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: the business's own word only: Rosie never requires a license or insurance and never checks one (D96); a clinician's license is for the business to add if it wants it shown; a license the owner says the work needs, and that a person doesn't hold, stops that person's bookings for it
license.who: each clinician, and the practice, if the owner adds one
license.ask: any license number the owner wants shown, in the invite reply or sent by the owner (optional)
license.insurance: optional: malpractice insurance the owner adds is shown as given; Rosie never checks it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, medicines, test results or the clinician's name (at a house call the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the patient needs an interpreter, and the office is told
